title: Partakers of the Heavenly Calling
excerpt: “Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus.”

content.text: Partakers of the Heavenly calling.
Hebrews 3:1:
“Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus.”

You are called to a heavenly life, different from the world. Set your heart on things above, remembering Christ’s return is near. Remember that you are in the world but not of the world, your origin and destiny is different you have been set apart. This also means that your method of operation ought to be different, we walk by faith and not by sight and in Christ your victory is guaranteed no matter what may come your way.
In these last days that we are living in it important to not let the cares of this world affect you so much that you lose sight of who you are. Watch what the scripture says.
Hebrews 3:6:

“But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.” Do not faint until you reach the finishing line. You must stand strong and hold firm to the hope you have in Christ.

The Lord Jesus is coming back for a triumphant church, that has subdued the enemy in His name and full of glory. Challenges will come in fact; they must come otherwise there is nothing for you to conquer. The epistle of James put it this way:
James 1: 2
Consider it all joy, my brothers and sisters, when you encounter various trials,

You might be thinking but pastor how do I count it all joy when I have just lost my job, when my child is sick? When you who it is that stands with you against that situation whooooo, your heart will be filled with joy because you know the outcome. Stop looking at it from a human perspective look at it from His, hallelujah! This was the mindset that David had, that Abraham had, they only needed to know the Lord is with them and nothing was impossible.
As you go through this week, leave no room for worry or discouragement, God is with you. You cannot be disadvantaged you cannot lose! Proclaim it, that is God’s testimony concerning your life!

author: Pastor Ronnie Dube

title: How to live victoriously
excerpt: The Word of God is building material for your life you cannot afford to treat it casually, esteem the God.s word highly in your life and the change...

content.text: The Word of God is building material for your life you cannot afford to treat it casually, esteem the God.s word highly in your life and the changes that you have been wanting to see will come to you quicker.
I have not departed from the commands of his lips; I have treasured the words of his mouth more than my daily bread.

Job said I treasured it more than my necessary food, you have to train your self to receive the Word of God when it comes to you. I have been in services where I have seen people write notes on pieces of paper that they lose the moment they leave that meeting, they have not esteemed the word they are hearing they don5 understand the communication that God is bringing to them. Some don’t even bother to write anything at all and still expect that the word of God is going to change their lives and things will be different.

You have to understand that Gods agency of change in your life is His Word. The rich man that found himself in hell begged Abraham to send Lazarus to go and warn his brothers that there is a hell and they must live right watch what the Bible says;
Luke 16: 29
Abraham replied, ‘They have Moses and the Prophets; let them listen to them.’
You have to understand that this is the mind of God concerning you, he has given you the word, to instruct you to build you up, to correct you , to encourage you. What do you need today?
2 Timothy 3: 16- 17

All Scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness, that the man of God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.”
He says that you may be complete, the word complete there means to be thoroughly furnished that means lacking or coming short in nothing at all. The writer of the book of Hebrews also encourages us;
Hebrews 2: 1 ISV
For this reason we must pay closer attention to the things we have heard, or we may drift away,

He tells us here that unless you intentionally pay close attention to the word that you are receiving you will certainly drift away from that revelation and your experience in life will be inconsistent with the things that you have professed to believe. You have to make up your mind that you are not going to let anything slip away from you but that the word of God will produce results in your life.
Proverbs 4: 20- 22
My son, pay attention to my words; incline your ear to my sayings. / Do not lose sight of them; keep them within your heart. / For they are life to those who find them, and health to the whole body.
Find implies that you had to search diligently.
Deuteronomy 4:9

Only be on your guard and diligently watch yourselves, so that you do not forget the things your eyes have seen, and so that they do not slip from your heart as long as you live. Teach them to your children and grandchildren.
Stick to the word, you will come out with a testimony!

author: Pastor Ronnie Dube

title: Stay connected!
excerpt: As we behold the glory of the Lord through His Word, we are transformed into His image from glory to glory.

content.text: 2 Corinthians 3: 18
As we behold the glory of the Lord through His Word, we are transformed into His image from glory to glory.

Everything in creation must remain attached to its source to stay alive. Just as a tree dies when uprooted from the soil, we must stay connected to our source—the Word of God—to remain spiritually alive. The Word says we are born of incorruptible seed through God’s living Word (I Peter 1:23-25). To flourish, we must stay connected to the Word. If your life is born from the Word of God, you must of necessity remain connected to the Word in order to stay alive.

This is the year of God’s glory. Each time we engage with the Word, we receive a deposit that transforms us from one level of glory to another. The more you look the more you are transformed hallelujah! A good person brings forth good from the treasure within (Luke 6:45). What we produce in life comes from within us. God’s Word plants good deposits in our hearts, so that good things come out of you.

God created us with purpose and destiny. His Word is the instrument that transforms us into what He predestined us to be. Remaining connected to the Word allows us to fulfill that purpose. God’s Word has the power to not only change you, but to orchestrate circumstances to align with His plan (Romans 12:2, Psalm 107:20). Agree with what God says about your life and hold on to His Word. Take time to meditate on what God says concerning your health this week, your finances, your children. Stay connected!

author: Pastor Ronnie Dube

title: Divine Authority
excerpt: And Jesus came and spake unto them saying, all power is given unto me in heaven and in earth. Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing the...

content.text: Matthew 28: 18- 19

And Jesus came and spake unto them saying, all power is given unto me in heaven and in earth. Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost.

The Greek word translated as power in our scripture for today is, exousia, it means authority or jurisdiction. Justbefore He went back to heaven, He said, “All authority has been given to Me in heaven and on earth. Go therefore…” Now watch this, that word, therefore, means ‘for that reason’. In other words, you could read it this way,
’ … all authority is given unto me in heaven and in earth, go for that reason, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name….’

The same authority that Jesus used to rebuke the storms, raise the dead, cast out devils and heal the sick is now ours to use. We have been given the power of attorney to use that name. So when there are reports of an epidemic and people are falling sick in the media, know that you have dominion over the epidemic. Declare, “By the authority given to me in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, this virus will not come near my household in the name of Jesus.
Faith Confession
Today I take authority over my finances, my marriage and my health in the name of Jesus! I cancel every plan of the enemy against my life in the name of Jesus.
Further Study
Matthew 8: 5- 13

author: Pastor Ronnie Dube

title: Currency of faith
excerpt: Now Faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen,

content.text: Currency of faith
Hebrews 11:1
Now Faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen,

Our scripture for today says; “Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.” In other words, faith gives evidence to, or makes concrete or tangible what the physical senses can’t perceive. God is a Spirit (John 4:24), and He operates from the spirit realm. To Him, things in that realm are more real than the things we perceive with our senses..

You no longer consider how the circumstance and just like old Abraham, you stagger not at the promise of God hallelujah! We have a currency of faith, that’s why the bible says that; without faith it is impossible to please God. Have Faith in the word of God and when you hear it, believe it and act upon what you believe, and you will surely come back with a testimony.
Faith Confession
I rule, reign and dominate my world today by the faith of God in my spirit! My faith is alive and producing results because the Word of God is in my heart and in my mouth,hallelujah!
Further study
Matthew 17:20

author: Pastor Ronnie Dube

title: Letting Go
excerpt: Brethren I count not myself to have apprehended; but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those t...

content.text: Letting Go
Philippians 3: 13
Brethren I count not myself to have apprehended; but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,

One of the tricks of the enemy is that he always makes it a point to remind you of your past failures and disappointments. There is a reason the past is called the past; it’s not your future. It is only dogs that go back to their past by way of eating their own vomit.
Paul had found a way to overcome this old trick of the devil, he said I forget those things which are behind so I can get a hold of what is before me.

Receive power today to break free from all guilt and shame. Jesus died and rose for you, so rise above your past. You are not your past; you are forgiven; celebrate and thank God for the good news. Your future is bright. Let that be your focus today as you make impact.
Confession
My past has nothing to do with my future. God does not condemn me and I also do not condemn myself. I am free and released to do great things in The Name of Jesus.
Further Study
Romans 5:8-13

author: Pastor Ronnie Dube

title: As He is
excerpt: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment because as he is; so are we in this world

content.text: 1 John 4:17
Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment because as he is; so are we in this world

In today’s scripture, I’d like to emphasize the part that says“as he is; so are we in this world”. Note; the Bible says we are exactly like Jesus whilst we are in this world not in the world to come. Is Jesus sick? Is he depressed or is Jesus poor? The answer is a definite no. So why is it we have somany who are living sub-standard lives yet claim to be His children? Scripture confirms that God doesn’t lie and whatever he says regarding your life is truthful. You need to gain full knowledge and understanding of who you are in the sight of God. This is the only way you can experience the full package and benefits of being a child of God.

Challenge that sickness and get it out of your system, it’s not yours to keep or nurse. Challenge lack and evict it from your life. You are a replica of God in this world and let every area of your life reflect that. Today is the day you get to embrace who you are and the power you carry so that you can effect change in every area of your life.
Confession
I am a representation of God in this world. From today the world shall see prosperity, good health, increaseand all good things through me. As He is so am I!
Further studies
2Corinthians 5:20

author: Pastor Ronnie Dube

title: Power of God
excerpt: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ, for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth, to the Jew first, and also to ...

content.text: Romans 1: 16
For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ, for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

The word translated gospel is the Greek word Euggelion, which means news nearly too good to be true. Each time you hear the gospel of Christ, you are hearing God’s good news for you. And the Bible tells us that the gospel of Christ—the good news that God wants all men to hear—is the very power of God for your salvation.

The only good news to the poor is that you don’t have to be broke another day in your life. Good news to the sick is that divine health is your portion. You see when the bible says it’s the power of God unto salvation its not just salvation from hell, but also from illnesses, financial lack, harm, a failing marriage—every aspect of your life that needs saving!

I have good news for you today, Christ has already paid for you to have perfect peace in this life, for you to have nothing missing and nothing broken. As you meditate on the good news today the power of God will begin to strengthen your mortal body and your finances will be restored in the name of Jesus!
Confession
I have moved from death to life by the power of the good news of God’s grace, I now live a life of abundance and prosperity in the name of Jesus.
Further Study
Colossians 2: 14

author: Pastor Ronnie Dube

title: Peace with God
excerpt: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.

content.text: Romans 5: 1
Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.

Through ignorance of the word of God many Christians live in condemnation and fear always thinking that God is mad at them. It is an old trick that the devil has used to oppress many in the body of Christ. The truth of the matter is that GOD IS NOT MAD AT YOU, HE IS MAD ABOUT YOU.

The peace we now enjoy with God is only as a result of one thing only, what Jesus has done for us. We could not approach God on our own. This is what the book of Isaiah records that,’ he was bruised for our iniquities and the chastisement for our peace was upon Him.’

God was, is and always will be satisfied with what Jesus did for us he is not looking to punish you again for what Jesus paid for, Christ has already been punished on your behalf so God is not looking for an excuse to punish the same crime twice. We can now enjoy peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ. Hallelujah!
Confession
I have peace through the Lord Jesus Christ, I no longer live in fear or condemnation. I have been justified by faith and I am free in the name of Jesus.
Further study
Isaiah 53: 5

author: Pastor Ronnie Dube

title: Grow by the God
excerpt: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word that ye may grow thereby.

content.text: 1 Peter 2:2
As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word that ye may grow thereby.

Growth isn’t a miracle and shouldn’t take a miracle; it’s the result of the application of revealed principles and means. Growth is intrinsic to life; it’s a natural course of life. Everything that has life grows; it’s one of the characteristics that differentiate living things from non-living things.

As a Christian, your spiritual growth is very important, and you can only grow by the Word. God’s Word is food for the human spirit.  The Word of God builds you and transforms your life from glory to glory. James 1:21 says, “…receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.” It’s like natural seeds that can only grow properly when planted in the right environment. If you want to grow spiritually, you must expose your spirit to the Word; you must feed on the Word.

With the Word in you, you’re able to tame the crisis of life. You’re able to take charge of your health. You know how to keep Satan and his cohorts in check. You enforce the will and dominion of Christ in your city, nation, and in the nations of the world. That’s part of Christian growth. Hallelujah!
